title: feat(web): one-click MCP install from the Connect panel

summaries.body:
## Maple review 🟢 **Confidence 8/10** · likely safe to merge Panel close rides on the shared `routeChanged` with no test of its own; I ran the deeplink encodings and they decode cleanly. 1 warning −1 · tests partial −1 · risk medium Reworks the Connect panel's MCP card into one install row per client and closes the panel on navigation through a new `ConnectPanel.close`. Safe to merge; the only gap is a test that exercises the helper rather than `routeChanged`. ### Findings
🟠 Warning · F1 · routeChanged's Connect-panel close is untested; the new test calls close directly tests · [`apps/web/src/shell/connect-panel.scene.test.ts:212-221`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/c7271ee1c7ddbdb73f9fdd420f31c79427873cab/apps/web/src/shell/connect-panel.scene.test.ts#L212-L221) The test named for navigation calls `close()` on the model built by the test, not `routeChanged`, so dropping `connect: () => connect.model` or the command mapping at `apps/web/src/shell/update.ts:225`-`231` leaves every test green while the panel stays open on navigation again. Drive it through `routeChanged(false)(opened)` the way `apps/web/src/shell/page-sheets.scene.test.ts:85` does for the filter sheet, and assert the dialog is gone. ``` Add a `routeChanged(false)(open(init()).model)` case in the shell scene test (or here) asserting `model.connect.popover.isOpen === false` and no commands, so the `update.ts` wiring is pinned, not only the `close` helper. ```
`c7271ee` · Updated on every push. Reply "won't fix" to dismiss a finding, or mention @maple-review-bot to ask about one.
